coding_context.reported_success_quote:
There were no main effect of weight on the
importance of having a voice in a decision-making procedure, importance of a book, and
importance of healthy eating. However, the present design was slightly different, as the authors
included three (counterbalanced) assessments of the effects. When the authors conducted the
analysis on the first measurement only in the counterbalanced design, they found the effects on
the perceived importance of a book, but with a smaller effect size than the original.
